decks.notes: The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity alongside token generators like Dwarven Mine to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding provide disruption while Wrenn and Six and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker offer card advantage and flexibility. The goal is to set up a board state where the opponent is overwhelmed by large threats and unable to effectively answer them. Prismatic Ending and Lightning Bolt provide additional removal options, while Change the Equation allows for card selection and digging for combo pieces.

This UR Aggro deck aims to put early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cheap counterspells and removal. Key cards include Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer for card advantage and Murktide Regent for a big threat. The deck also utilizes efficient cantrips and card filtering to maintain card advantage and consistency. Blood Moon can disrupt multicolor decks, while the inclusion of a few lands that can be sacrificed for card advantage adds to the deck's versatility. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through aggressive creatures and efficient spells.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while using efficient counterspells like Spell Snare and Counterspell to protect them. The deck also utilizes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board and finish off opponents. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game until it can secure a win. Additionally, card selection tools like Expressive Iteration and Consider help ensure consistency in draws and plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing cascade mechanics to rapidly deploy threats and disrupt opponents. By casting spells with cascade, the deck can chain together multiple spells for little to no mana cost, overwhelming the opponent with a rapid and consistent stream of threats. The deck includes various disruptive spells and efficient creatures to maintain pressure on the opponent while controlling the board. The key strategy is to efficiently cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to create a powerful threat. By utilizing equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice and Shadowspear, as well as protective cards like Sigarda's Aid and Giver of Runes, the deck aims to provide evasion, protection, and card advantage to overwhelm the opponent. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for key pieces, while Esper Sentinel provides card draw and disrupts the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck focuses on creating a fast and efficient win condition through the combo.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, with an emphasis on low-cost and efficient spells like Prismatic Ending, Unholy Heat, and Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck also features cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer for card advantage and pressure. The mana base is designed to support the combo with fetch lands and dual lands.

This deck focuses on using creatures with ETB effects to create a toolbox of options for different situations. By using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can tutor for specific creatures to combo off or disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes mana ramp and fixing with cards like Birds of Paradise, Wall of Roots, and Nurturing Peatland to ensure it can consistently cast its spells. The key strategy is to establish a board presence and utilize creature synergies to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays using cheap, efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, supported by disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The deck also includes graveyard recursion with cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Grief, as well as unique combat tricks with Feign Death and Undying Malice. The inclusion of Blood Moon can also disrupt opponents' mana bases and give the deck an edge in certain matchups. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The key focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to control the board. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Undying Malice and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to protect and enhance its creatures. The inclusion of Blood Moon can also disrupt opponents' mana bases. Overall, this deck aims to maintain control of the battlefield while applying relentless aggression.

The deck focuses on dealing quick and direct damage to the opponent, utilizing burn spells and fast creatures to reduce their life total as quickly as possible. It includes a variety of efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike, as well as creature threats like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The goal is to maintain pressure on the opponent from the beginning of the game, preventing them from stabilizing and ultimately burning them out before they can mount a defense. The deck prioritizes speed and efficiency in dealing damage over long-term strategic planning.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the cards like Living End, Architects of Will, and Violent Outburst to set up a powerful combo that allows the player to cheat out high-cost creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Striped Riverwinder. The deck also includes cards like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent to help cycle through the deck quickly and find the necessary combo pieces. With the inclusion of disruption cards like Force of Negation and Grief, the deck aims to control the board while setting up its game-winning combo.

The key concept of this deck is to control the board through removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Flame Slash while also utilizing big red creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure. Blood Moon helps disrupt opponents' mana bases, while cards like Seasoned Pyromancer provide card advantage. The companion Obosh, the Preypiercer enhances the damage output of odd-cost spells in the deck. Overall, the strategy focuses on a mix of control elements and aggressive threats to dominate the battlefield in a Modern 1 vs 1 setting.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize, Grief, and Seasoned Pyromancer, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck utilizes removal spells such as Terminate and Fatal Push to control the board and clear the way for its creatures to attack. Blood Moon is included to disrupt mana bases and slow down opponents, while Feign Death and Undying Malice provide additional ways to protect and recur key threats. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruption and aggression.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to turn tokens generated by Dwarven Mine into powerful creatures, such as Archon of Cruelty. Teferi, Time Raveler is used to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's plans. Leyline Binding and Prismatic Ending provide removal and control options, while Wrenn and Six help with recurring lands. The deck also includes some utility lands like Jetmir's Garden and Xander's Lounge. Overall, the deck aims to create a powerful board presence through unique combos and creative plays.

This deck focuses on utilizing Cascade mechanic to continuously cast powerful spells for free while putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures. By cascading into cards like Crashing Footfalls or Dead/Gone, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect its game plan. The inclusion of versatile creatures like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent provides additional ways to pressure the opponent and close out the game.

The main concept of the deck is to assemble a powerful combo by equipping Colossus Hammer onto Inkmoth Nexus or another creature to deal lethal infect damage in a single attack. The deck utilizes Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to tutor for and equip the necessary pieces quickly, while also including support cards like Sigarda's Aid and Esper Sentinel for protection and card advantage. Urza's Saga is included to search for key artifacts, while the inclusion of efficient creatures like Memnite and Ornithopter help to quickly set up the combo. A strong and fast-paced strategy centered around equipment and combo potential.
